questions.question: If Sunday is coded as January, Tuesday as March, Thursday as May, then Saturday will be coded as:
questions.solution:

Sunday (1st day of the week) coded as → January (1st month)

Tuesday (3rd day of the week) coded as → March (3rd month)

Thursday (5th day of the week) coded as → May (5th month)

Similarly,

** Saturday (7th day of the week) coded as → July (7th month)**

​Hence, "July" is the correct answer
